events.title: The Fallout Shelter: Werkout Plan, Mr Rabbit & The Silent Ech0
events.description:
Ypsilanti's weekly Wednesday night at the Regal Beagle, presented by Ech0labs Light Industries and Wax Kings. Five years in.

Werkout Plan is a Detroit house project known for heavy house beats, deep basslines and catchy vocals, part of the Never B Alone Records, OFDM Records and Late Night Munchies crews. Mr Rabbit (Mr Rabbit313) plays a live set, a first at the Fallout Shelter. The Silent Ech0 started the Fallout Shelter at 734 Brewing on December 31, 2021 and has held it down ever since, across house, techno and Detroit techno.

Live visuals by Yaboonabi.

House, Techno and Tech House.

$5 at the door (cash or Venmo). 18+. No step at the door. Cash bar. 7:30pm to midnight.
